purpose: Canonical freshness/provenance contract for non-Rates dashboard layers. Audit/refresh date must never be conflated with underlying observation dates.

rules: audit_date is the date the layer was checked/rebuilt, not the maximum observation date
component_as_of carries the actual observation/release date for every materially distinct component
do not infer freshness from repository commit/file modification timestamps
do not mark a component stale merely because its observation date is old; compare against source release cadence
if current same-basis data cannot be validated, retain the last validated snapshot and mark WITHHELD rather than mixing sources
source_quality must distinguish official, official-manual, validated-secondary and mirror/transport sources
dashboard labels must expose both layer audit date and material component as-of dates when they differ

special_rules: respect native frequency: monthly, quarterly and rolling-window series have different natural ages
rolling labour windows must expose reference_period separately from release_date when available
a single currency as_of is not authoritative when inflation and labour dates differ

GBP.labour.interpretation: rolling-period reference, not evidence of a June-only stale release

CB.component_granularity: currency x policy decision / market pricing
special_rules: policy decision date and market-pricing as_of must be separate
secondary futures quotes may be usable but must never be labeled official-current
pre-decision market pricing becomes stale immediately after a decision unless explicitly revalidated post-decision

AUD.market_pricing.reason: pre-decision snapshot; official ASX post-decision settlement exists

special_rules: mixed-frequency components require separate component_as_of dates
layer-level as_of is informational only and must not overwrite component dates
current-by-cadence is allowed when an older date is still the latest officially released observation
CFTC report date must be judged against the official weekly release schedule
price confirmation is a separate component and may remain WITHHELD without invalidating the positioning snapshot
all G8 currencies should share the same CFTC report date for a canonical weekly snapshot

G8.price_confirmation.reason: price was not recalculated in the same COT refresh

dashboard_presentation_contract.unless: every material component has independently passed the relevant source-cadence/currentness gate
